text: 17.4 mpg for Chrysler and GM, which represents their fuel economy in MY 1979 based on their voluntary plans minus the fuel economy penalty for each due to the MY 1979 emission standard. The gasoline savings below are based on the manufacturers' plans with the maximum fuel economy penalty indicated by the manufacturers due to the MY 1979 emission standard. If the penalty is less than these maxima, the savings would be less. Under these assumptions, the annual consumption of gasoline per vehicle for a production weighted fleet average fuel economy in MY 1979 of 17.4 mpg would be 632 gallons. The annual consumption of gasoline for a production weighted fleet average fuel economy in MY 1979 of 17.8 mpg would be 618 gallons. The annual consumption of gasoline for a production weighted fleet average fuel economy in MY 1979 of 18.7 mpg would be 588 gallons. Thus, the annual savings of gasoline per vehicle would be between 14 gallons and 44 gallons and the lifetime savings would be between 140 gallons and 440 gallons. The annual consumption of gasoline for the fleet for a production weighted fleet average fuel economy in MY 1979 of 17.4 mpg would be 474 million gallons.
